text:
Sam (AE): quick question — AltCorp (pilot -> enterprise) wants to move forward but asked for 50% annual upfront for year1, then Net75 on the remainder invoiced quarterly for years 2-4. also wants invoices sent to their procurement portal and a mandatory PO for each year. can we approve?
Maria (DealDesk): @Sam can you paste the ARR / SKU and the discount they're asking for? need to check against commit bands. :eyes: 
Sam (AE): they're at $450k ARR committed over 4 years (total contract value $1.8M). asking for 25% discount for the multi-year commit and the 50% upfront to reduce their internal approvals.
Maria (DealDesk): 25% is outside standard for that tier. need DealDesk + Finance signoff on invoice timing and discount. Also ping legal for PO wording and payment security. cc @Sophia (Finance) @Tony (Legal)
decalibot: dealbot created opportunity ALT-ENT-0045, stage: Contracting, owner: Sam
Sophia (Finance): 50% upfront is OK from cashflow perspective, but Net75 on remaining balance will require invoicing cadence spelled out. we need: invoice schedule, GL codes, and confirmation of remit address. Also confirm if they require escrow or payment guarantee for the balance.
Sam (AE): they want invoice schedule like this:
```
Year 1: 50% upfront on signing (invoice #1)
Year 1 remainder: invoice #2 for the rest, due Net75
Years 2-4: annual invoices on the anniversary, each due Net75, plus end-of-year true-up for usage over committed tokens
```
Sam (AE): procurement portal URL: https://altcorp.procure.example/po-portal (they said they will attach PO after our invoice)
Maria (DealDesk): merchant risk: Net75 is long. if Legal can't add payment security, we should consider milestone invoicing or require a bank guarantee. @Tony?
Tony (Legal): can add language for PO acceptance and invoicing flow. Net75 is acceptable if we have: (1) annual PO attached to each invoice, (2) Right to suspend on non-payment after 15 days late post-Net75 grace, and (3) clawback clause if they cancel mid-term. need to review SOW and SLA to ensure suspension doesn't violate uptime SLA credits.
Jess (ProductSec): also flag: private deployment data residency note in SOW for AltCorp. they requested on-prem option for year 3. that changes billing (work order + professional services). need to ensure PS fees are invoiced separately and not part of the ARR discounting calculus.
Sam (AE): underlined: they want discount applied to platform only, not PS. confirmed. PS will be separate PO line.
Maria (DealDesk): action items for approval: [1] DealDesk approve 25% discount for platform on $1.8M TCV? [2] Finance approve Net75 + 50% upfront schedule and revenue recognition plan? [3] Legal to review PO/termination/suspension language?
Sophia (Finance): approve contingent on finance controls: we require invoices to include a payment term section, and we need CFO signature on the booking if effective AR > $1M with Net75 outstanding. also request aging report cadence and escrow discussion.
Maria (DealDesk): thanks. I can approve 25% discount on the condition that we add a deferral schedule and escrow/guarantee for >90 days exposure. I'll mark as provisional.
Tony (Legal): I'll draft amendment language: add PO acceptance clause, payment guarantee option, and 15-day suspension post-due. sending draft in thread.
Tony (Legal): sending initial language snippet:
```
"Customer shall issue a valid purchase order for each annual invoice. For any invoices unpaid more than Seventy-Five (75) days after invoice date, Redwood may suspend Services after fifteen (15) calendar days' written notice. Customer shall provide either: (a) an irrevocable standby letter of credit, or (b) an escrow arrangement or (c) a mutually acceptable payment guarantee to secure unpaid amounts > $250,000."
```
Sam (AE): perfect. I'll share with AltCorp procurement and ask if they can do L/C or escrow.
dealbot: attached contract: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ALT-ENT-0045/contract-draft.pdf
Maria (DealDesk): final checklist for approval: - Confirm AltCorp can issue annual POs on portal - Confirm PS invoicing is separate - Confirm escrow or LOC option - Legal amendment signed - Finance signs off on AR exposure. If all yes, DealDesk approves discount and the 50% upfront schedule.
AltCorp Procurement (via Sam): altcorp-purchasing@altcorp.com: we can do annual PO in portal. escrow is preferred over LOC. can you send escrow beneficiary details and timeline?
Sophia (Finance): escrow preferred acceptable. provide bank/contact for beneficiary. finance needs 10 business days to set up escrow agreement with treasury once we get beneficiary details.
Sam (AE): noted. AltCorp also asked if we can put milestone invoices on net30 for PS only (their SOW requires faster PS payment).
Tony (Legal): fine to keep PS net30, just ensure PS invoice header references the SOW and separate GL. I'll include that.
Maria (DealDesk): marking this as pending final docs. If Legal and Finance confirm via thread, I'll move to approved and update deal desk sheet. Can someone drop "Approved" once done? :white_check_mark: 
Tony (Legal): draft done, sent to Sam via email for review with AltCorp.
Sophia (Finance): finance sign-off: approved pending escrow beneficiary and final invoice template.
Maria (DealDesk): DealDesk: APPROVED (provisional) — conditions noted. Sam, please upload signed amendment + escrow confirmation to the opportunity.
Sam (AE): will do. thanks everyone! :tada:
